summary: Changed paddleLeft/Right from wraparound `(padX +/- 4) & 0xFF` to clamped `Math.max(0, padX-4)` / `Math.min(58, padX+4)` so the 6px-wide paddle (0xFC) stays fully on screen (0..58). Ball divergences are downstream knock-ons: different padX changes paddle-ball collisions, altering ball trajectory.
